title: Wieferich Primes in Ordowski's Congruences
description: Answers to Thomas Ordowski's questions on OEIS A051903. No odd n with a repeated prime factor satisfies b^n = b^a(n) (mod n) for every base b, while for the base 2 such n exist; the least is 9687963167864344937 = 7 * 631 * 881 * 3511^2 * 201961. Includes the paper, Lean 4 proofs checked against the Formal Conjectures statements, and the search code.
